condition_prompts.named: The additional image is an enlarged {location} region of the original image. Reconsider your answer using the available visual evidence. Answer the question using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.
condition_prompts.neutral: The additional image is an enlarged region of the original image. Reconsider your answer using the available visual evidence. Answer the question using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.
condition_prompts.sham: The additional image is an enlarged {location} region of the original image. Reconsider your answer using the available visual evidence. Answer the question using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.
condition_prompts.frame: The additional image is an enlarged {location} region of the original image. Reconsider your answer using the available visual evidence. Answer spatial questions in the coordinate frame of the first, original full image, not the additional image. Answer the question using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.

direct_prompt_contract.system_instruction: You answer questions accurately based on the provided images.
direct_prompt_contract.question_template:
{question}
Answer the question using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.

view_contract.sham_description: Intentionally incorrect quadrant claim for a repeated full overview; image/text incongruity is part of the intervention.

analysis.condition_score: mean correctness over all four quadrants, then equal-image mean
analysis.confidence_interval: 95% percentile; descriptive and unadjusted across contrasts
analysis.inversion_eligibility: reference and parsed prediction both normalize to exactly left or right

execution.action_order: direct first; shuffle the sixteen follow-ups per image from canonical actions[1:]
execution.branch_start: same fresh direct-answer conversation for every follow-up
execution.resume: only identical run identity; retain completed records
execution.timing: full path for every new call; follow-up total equals fresh direct plus incremental call
